# BHUVAN PS

Data Engineer . Full Australian Work Rights | Melbourne, VIC | 0451 412 465
[psbhuvan2002@gmail.com](mailto:psbhuvan2002@gmail.com) | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhuvan-ps) | [GitHub](https://github.com/BhuvanPS) | [Portfolio](https://bhuvanps.github.io/Portfolio/)


## SUMMARY

A Data Science Graduate with 2+ years of experience across machine learning, data engineering, analytics and full-stack software
delivery, spanning time series forecasting, ETL pipelines, BI dashboards and production app development. Skilled in preparing,
cleansing and analysing large, complex datasets to build, evaluate and deploy models that translate into measurable business
outcomes, and in communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across data, analytics and
technology functions.


## TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Python, R, SQL, Dart, JavaScript

AI/ML: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry

Data Engineering: Microsoft Fabric, PySpark, Delta Lake, ETL pipelines, Firebase

Cloud & DevOps: GCP, Azure, GitHub, CI/CD

Visualisation: Power BI, Streamlit, R Shiny

Frameworks: FastAPI, Flutter, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google Agent Development


## WORK EXPERIENCE


### Junior Al Engineer . Al-Driven Bushfire Forecasting . InnovAlte, Melbourne February 2026 - June 2026

. Architected a unified model input schema with 14+ physically grounded variables and a fixed tensor shape, establishing cross-
stream API contract across 3 teams (AI, Backend, Frontend) and unblocking parallel development before production data was
available.

. Conducted statistical validation (stationarity, distribution and trend analysis) on 5,000 synthetic fire records to confirm suitability
for time series forecasting, then engineered an 8-phase pipeline benchmarking 7 architectures (LSTM, Transformer, CNN-LSTM,
TCN, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Persistence) - achieving 79.8% severity classification accuracy and identifying
Transformer as primary candidate with 0.22ms inference latency.

. Synthesised a physically grounded fire record generator and Model-as-a-Service FastAPI deployment guide, enabling model
prototyping and backend integration before production data was available.

Junior Data Engineer . Healthcare Al . Gopher Industries, Melbourne
July 2025 - December 2025

. Deployed patient-specific Random Forest models (62.5% accuracy) for real-time anomaly detection across 50,000+ clinical
data points, enabling early-stage risk stratification that drove 50% faster treatment decisions.

. Engineered scalable ETL pipelines for temporal aggregation and rule-based labelling across multi-dimensional health signals -
vital signs, activity, and nutrition - with strong data governance ensuring clinical data integrity.

. Delivered an interactive Streamlit dashboard surfacing real-time clinical risk scores, stability analysis, and patient insights for
non-technical healthcare professionals.

Software Consultant Radstec, California, USA (Remote)
June 2024 - December 2024

. Built an Al-powered appointment booking solution using Amazon Lex, cutting scheduling time by 20% and reducing manual
enquiries by 30%.

. Developed a self-updating customer support chatbot using Google Vertex Al, integrated with automated web scraping to
refresh responses in real-time whenever the client's website was updated - eliminating stale support content.

Full Stack Developer CuroWebs, India
January 2024 - July 2024

. Spearheaded end-to-end delivery of C-Meds, a production Flutter mobile app spanning UI, backend, and Play Store release -
reaching 300+ downloads and 100+ active users within months of launch.

. Eliminated 90% of manual medical data entry by architecting a serverless GCP Cloud Functions pipeline integrated with Gemini
Vision API, achieving near-zero human error in patient record capture.

. Accelerated release cycles by instituting GitHub version control and configuring repeatable deployment pipelines across the
collaborative dev team.


### PROJECTS

Fitness Coaching Al Platform Python . Microsoft Agent Framework . Azure OpenAl . Multi-Agent Orchestration

. Architected a 6-agent fitness coaching platform using Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAl, designing 40 custom
tool functions across workout, nutrition, billing, scheduling, and user management domains.

. Engineered sequential and concurrent multi-agent workflows orchestrating up to 5 specialist agents in parallel, achieving a 5x
reduction in execution time and 70% reduction in administrative overhead.

[HyperScale Retail Command Center](https://bhuvanps.github.io/Portfolio/Hyperscale/) Microsoft Fabric . PySpark . Delta Lake . Power BI . Facebook Prophet

. Implemented end-to-end real-time analytics on Microsoft Fabric, unifying historical sales and live order streams into a
Medallion Architecture using Delta Lake and PySpark ETL.

<!-- PageBreak -->

. Generated 30-day demand forecasts using Facebook Prophet and surfaced sub-minute stockout alerts via Fabric Activator,
cutting response time from hours to under 60 seconds.

[Bank Loan Performance Analysis](https://bhuvanps.github.io/Portfolio/Loan_Analysis_Report/) Power BI . DAX . Financial Analysis . KPIs

. Designed a three-tier Power BI dashboard monitoring a $435.8M loan portfolio, implementing complex DAX measures for
MTD/MoM performance tracking and trend analysis.

. Delivered data-driven risk exposure and debt consolidation insights, surfacing an 86.2% Good Loan rate and identifying
actionable levers for portfolio optimisation.

E-Cell SASTRA Mobile App Flutter . Dart . Firebase . GCP

. Led development and Play Store launch of a Flutter mobile app, managing 1,000+ event registrations across the university
community.

. Implemented networking features that reduced manual communication by 40%, streamlining coordination between students
and organisers.

. Achieved 500+ downloads and enhanced user engagement through a streamlined, mobile-first interface.


## EDUCATION


### Master of Data Science - Deakin University, Melbourne | WAM: 80 June 2024 - June 2026

Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Wrangling, Statistical Data Analysis, Mathematics for AI

Bachelor's in Computer Science & Engineering - SASTRA University | CGPA: 8.62/10
October 2020 - June 2024

Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, Computer Networks, Software Engineering Practices


## ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERSHIP

. Google DeepMind Al Sprint - Top 9: Selected in top 9 teams at Google DeepMind Al Sprint (LocalLoop project) from a highly
competitive national field.

. GovHack Australia - Honourable Mention: Received Honourable Mention for Victoria Green Transit Strategy, identifying
$15M in regenerative economy potential and a projected 25% environmental impact reduction.

. Technical Coordinator - E-Cell, SASTRA: Promoted from Developer to Technical Coordinator; led a 24-28 person developer
team on the E-Cell SASTRA mobile platform.
